_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The capabilities generator fails if the source names below do not match the probe exactly, and the integration suite restores from the images listed under verified — the baseline on every run, the rest in the scheduled version matrix and before a release tag — so neither can drift. The official duckdb/duckdb images carry only the engine binary — no shell, not even a way to idle (measured) — so the suite runs the wrapper image the adapter README documents, built FROM the listed image; the engine exercised is exactly the listed version's. The baseline is the 1.4 line, DuckDB's designated LTS. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
name: DuckDB

sources.duckdb_db: One database file (a copy of a cleanly closed database)
sources.duckdb_db_dir: A directory of database files; the newest by file time is restored (the header records no wall clock)
sources.duckdb_export: One `EXPORT DATABASE` directory (schema.sql, load.sql and one data file per table, CSV or Parquet)
